overview_description.description:
PalletPal is a logistics technology company that provides a digital freight forwarding and supply-chain management platform for businesses moving cargo to and from the Middle East and North Africa (MENA).
PalletPal operates an online platform that allows companies to book, compare, and manage international freight shipments through a network of logistics providers. The platform supports transportation by sea, air, and road, helping businesses coordinate cross-border cargo movements using a centralized digital system.

about_short_description.short_description: PalletPal is a logistics technology company that provides a digital freight forwarding and supply-chain management platform.

product.name: Digital Freight Platform
product.description: A platform that enables booking and management of sea, air, and road cargo shipments with multiple logistics partners in one place.

product.name: Freight Quote Comparison Service
product.description: A service that provides multiple freight quotes quickly, allowing users to compare and select optimal shipping offers with transparent pricing.

product.name: Shipment Visibility and Tracking
product.description: A feature providing end-to-end visibility and regular status updates on shipments, along with centralized storage of shipment documentation.

product.name: Supply Chain Data Insights
product.description: A service that provides data analytics and insights from shipment tracking and documentation to support supply chain decision-making.

product.name: Dedicated Freight Support Team
product.description: A team of experts providing assistance and support throughout the shipping process from origin to destination.
